title: Load a recorded screenshot
responsibility: Loads the selected runtime screenshot for the shown project and commit, reports its loading state, and releases the image when the view is finished.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: The shown project snapshot, project context, pinned-commit setting and evidence connection. Without a snapshot or evidence reader, the preview reports that recorded screenshots cannot be read.

inputs.name: entityId
inputs.description: The exact entity whose runtime screenshot is requested. The evidence answer must identify this entity and the shown commit, and must match the project when the request names one.

inputs.name: thumbnail
inputs.description: A recorded-thumbnail selection. Supply scenario, state and viewport together, or leave all three absent. A partial selection is an error. When absent, the function looks for a recorded scenario state that explicitly names the entity and is required, preferring its desktop screenshot viewport when available.

inputs.name: apply
inputs.description: Receives loading immediately, then ready with an image URL and caption, missing with a reason, or error with a reason. Only a usable stored screenshot matching the selected scenario, state and viewport can become ready. The caption names the state and original tested commit, including whether the image was inherited. Read failures, mismatched identity, damaged bytes and media other than PNG or JPEG report error.

outputs.name: stop
outputs.description: A cleanup function to call when the preview is replaced or removed. It ignores late results and releases any image URL already created; it does not cancel the underlying request.
